tool_input.command:
git add Makefile .github/workflows/test.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(build): pin lint tool versions once, run golangci-lint fmt (L9, L10)

golangci-lint, staticcheck, and govulncheck versions were each
hardcoded twice -- once in the Makefile, once in
.github/workflows/test.yml -- exactly the version-pin drift this
bead's golangci-lint adoption is meant to eliminate. Pin each once in
a Makefile variable (STATICCHECK_VERSION, GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION,
GOVULNCHECK_VERSION), extract standalone `vet` and `staticcheck`
targets, and have CI invoke `make vet`/`make staticcheck`/
`make lint-strict`/`make vulncheck` instead of duplicating the
versioned commands.

Also change `make format` to run `golangci-lint fmt` (gofumpt +
goimports, matching lint-strict's formatters) instead of plain
`gofmt -s -w`, so a developer running `make format` produces output
that actually satisfies `make check`.
EOF
)"
